text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 5) 2018.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 23 Disember 2018 hingga 27 Disember 2018.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing tempatan bertulang

2. Daging kambing dan bebiri import bertulang

3. Ayam belanda import

4. Tomato

5. Kepak ayam

6. Lada benggala hijau

7. Babi hidup

8. Daging babi (perut)

9. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 18 Disember 2018

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/X]

DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri

dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 5) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 5) Order 2018.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 23 December 2018 to 27 December 2018.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local bone-in mutton

2. Imported bone-in mutton

3. Imported turkey

4. Tomato

5. Chicken wing

6. Green capsicum

7. Live pig

8. Pork (belly)

9. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 18 December 2018

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/X]

DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

Minister of Domestic Trade

and Consumer Affairs
